THE HEART BEHIND THE OVEN

Hi, I’m Pasha.
Your neighborhood baker.

Welcome to Pashabakess!

Hi, I’m Pasha, the baker behind Pashabakess! One of my favorite creative activities has always been baking, but it took on a far deeper significance after I became a stay-at-home mom. Pashabakess offers handmade gourmet cookies that are warm and nostalgic. Every cookie is thoughtfully crafted using ingredients I genuinely love, attention to detail, and lots of love and extra care.

My goal is to make every treat feel special, whether you’re rewarding yourself after a hard day, sharing a box with your friends, or celebrating a special occasion. I hope my cookies bring a little comfort and happiness to your table.

Thank you for supporting my small business and letting me share my love of baking with you. Here’s to many more sweet moments, one cookie at a time!

With love, Pasha
